ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Neptune

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your career and your image. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between relationships and your career. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between family and relationships. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between conversations and routine. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between money and romance. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your image and family. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
From {H:1798409572000}, the Moon moves into {S:5} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The square between Mercury and Neptune creates some tension between friendships and money. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.
